Noah (Head PM): Quick thread to lock the pragmatic GA scope for Console Observability. Aim: deliver value to small customers while keeping infra risk low.
Tara (Product): Proposed GA basket: 1) "lite" ops dashboard (4 panels: latency, p95, cost, errors), 2) per-route cost breakdown (tokens + cache hit), 3) error aggregation with links to sample traces, 4) simple sampling controls in Console.
Diego (Eng PM): Agree on lite dashboard. We should call out what we explicitly defer: scheduled exports, full raw-span retention, and long-tail per-tenant histograms.
Avery (Backend): Implementation note: per-route cost can be computed from existing telemetry if we add a small aggregation layer. Low-risk. Traces -> we can store sampled spans for 48h and build an aggregate index for 90d.
Kai (SRE): Risk constraints: tracing must have a global kill-switch, per-region disable, and per-tenant upper bound. Recommend limits: 5k spans/min default, enterprise opt-up. Also need alerting for trace budget exhaustion.
Olivia (Support): Customers want to be able to see cost by model-version and export quick CSVs for invoicing. If CSV is GA+1, we need a mitigation: in GA provide a UI "download aggregates" button for ad-hoc billing pulls.
Diego (Eng PM): Good idea. Plan: ship ad-hoc aggregate download in GA, schedule recurring CSV in GA+1. That keeps GA small.
Tara (Product): Acceptance criteria for GA (proposed):
- Lite dashboard deployed with tenant & model filters.
- Per-route cost panel with token and cache-hit metrics.
- Error aggregation: overall error rate + top-5 error buckets, each item links to sampled trace list.
- Sampling control: Console toggle + per-route "hot" override.
- Admin controls: kill-switch + per-tenant caps documented.
Noah (Head PM): Can we add a simple synthetic smoke check to validate tracing + dashboard pipelines post-deploy? Useful guardrail for on-call.
Avery (Backend): Yes. We'll add a lightweight synthetic that emits a known trace and metric every 5m; failing to see it triggers an alert.
Kai (SRE): Also add an automated scrubber: hash high-cardinality fields (session_id, prompt_text) and only keep plaintext for sampled top-reasons. Protects storage.
Diego (Eng PM): Timeline ask: can Eng deliver this in 5 weeks if we scope exports to GA+1?
Avery (Backend): 5 weeks is tight but doable if we freeze new product additions and focus the squad. Need 2 sprints: agg layer + dashboard templates, 1 sprint for tracing hooks + sampling UI, 1 sprint for alerts + synthetic.
Tara (Product): Tradeoffs: if we need to compress further, drop model-version filter from GA and add later. But many enterprise customers asked for model breakouts.
Olivia (Support): Strong ask for model-version in GA. It's used in billing disputes.
Noah (Head PM): Let's keep model-version in GA, but postpone scheduled CSV. Agreed?
Kai (SRE): I can sign off if we enforce caps, provide kill-switches, and include PD playbook for trace storms. Otherwise SRE won't support GA.
Diego (Eng PM): Action items:
- Avery: PR for aggregation service + synthetic probe (due EOD Thu)
- Kai: PD playbook + caps + rollback steps (due tomorrow morning)
- Tara: Final acceptance criteria doc + comms draft (due EOD)
- Olivia: Customer-facing FAQ draft about limits and GA+1 features (due EOD)
ci-bot: CI: dashboard-service -> staging passed (sha: def456).
Avery (Backend): :thumbsup: starting work on the PRs now. Will flag if infra quotas block us.
Noah (Head PM): Thanks team. I'll update the roadmap ticket and call out GA vs GA+1 features. If blockers surface we'll reconvene.
